Requirements summary / technical notes:
- Primary workloads: chat (low-latency p95 target 80-120ms), knowledge-search/doc-ranking (reranking top-10 at <200ms), embeddings for index updates (throughput-sensitive, cost-sensitive).
- Target throughput: sustained 40-60 QPS chat during business hours; bursts to 150 QPS. Embeddings pipeline 300-500 items/minute off-peak.
- Cost sensitivity: strong — product org wants to show 30-50% cost improvement vs current managed provider before committing to Dedicated.
- Model preferences: open weights preferred (Mistral-like/LLama variants), willingness to evaluate quantized variants; fallback policy needed to route to smaller model during overload.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, tracing to map upstream service calls to inference costs.
- Compliance: must support SAML SSO, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for subset of customers.

POC specifics / metrics observed so far:
- Baseline hosted_api (default config): chat avg latency 95ms, p95 180ms under synthetic bursts; cost per 1M tokens = $72 (example).
- With batching (embeddings): effective per-vector cost down by ~25% at batch=16.
- With prefix/KV caching (chat): repeated QPS for same session showed 15% token delta reduction and p95 improved by ~10-15ms.
- Quantization trials: 8-bit runs reduced memory and allowed larger batch sizes; 4-bit need tuning for quality regressions (SE note).
